notes: Reader A, part 2: sample_index 40 to 79 (40 rows, 213 drawn units). Every row has one numbered line and no unnumbered continuation line; I checked 38 pt above and 48 pt below each box in wide renders and the line below each target was always another numbered row or blank page. The printed_line_crops list therefore matched the physical lines in every row. Codes were chosen by comparing each unit with the position-chart cards (and the original sign list on PDF pages 20 and 21), at high magnification for small details. Coincident cards are kept as sets: 8/764 (single stroke), 9/765 (two strokes), 10/766 (three strokes), 543/769 (two strokes, underlined), 501/768 (single stroke, underlined) and 435/436. Underline presence was part of the code: a dashed line spanning a sign cell was attributed to the sign directly above it, and dashes between two rows were attributed to the upper row. Seven crops are marked incorrect. Rows 44, 48, 55, 58 and 66 include the tops of the next numbered row at the bottom edge. Rows 76 and 77 end at the proposed box edge (511 pt and 251 pt) while the last hatched patch continues to about 517 pt and 254.9 pt, so the patch and, in row 77, its underline are clipped; I read those two patches from the original page. Many other crops are much wider than the drawing and contain only blank space or dust specks; I did not count that as an error because no drawing ink is lost and no neighbour ink is included. Narrow hatched patches: the patch at the start of rows 53, 55, 77 and 78 ends 1.5 to 3.3 pt before the next sign cell, which supports the right-edge cards 598/542, and the patch width (6.4 to 6.6 pt) fits card 598 (6.7 pt) better than 597 (5.5 pt). The last unit of rows 78 and 79 is a narrow patch that starts where the previous sign cell ends, which supports the left-edge card 597; I kept 598 as shape-only there because the patch has no following cell to check against. Two units have an empty strict set. Row 51 unit 9 is the mirror image of card 241 (bow-tie with a gapped left side and a full right side) and no card shows that orientation. Row 70 unit 5 is a single tick at the top of the row about 2.4 pt long without underline; card 1 has that length but is centred, card 23 is high but only 0.75 pt long, and card 258 is high and long but underlined. Corrections made while reading: a Y with a central stroke between the arms is 126 (151 when underlined), not the plain Y 443; the diamond with one hook-shaped notch near the upper right is card 162 once the card is viewed at high magnification, not a diamond with extra elements. Convention points that were hard to apply: choosing between 597 and 598 for a patch that ends a line, deciding whether two adjacent stroke groups (row 65) are one unit, and treating compounds such as the two strokes plus slash of row 58 (spacing equals card 250) as a single unit. I rendered PDF areas at 3 to 24 pixels per point, above the suggested two, to read thin strokes and tick counts. Scratch renders and helper scripts were kept only in data/raw/2026-10-07-helsinki1979-digitization/reader-tmp-v3-A2/ and that folder is deleted at the end. I saw no prediction, frame, pipeline output, other reader's readings or earlier evaluation material; the only exposure is the two folder listings described in files_opened (file names, no contents).
